stories.title: Zubeen Garg (19 September, age 52)
stories.body: Assamese music icon; died in Singapore; famed for "Ya Ali" (Gangster, 2006); state funeral on 23 September.

stories.title: ICGS Adamya commissioned at Paradip (19 September)
stories.body: the first of eight Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessels for the Coast Guard.
